lubimov.name: Lubimov (warder)
lubimov.description: A camp warder in his fifties with a flat Russian accent speaking English. A dry, thin, nasal voice, slightly high and pinched, clipped and precise, an official monotone with no warmth at all; every word separate, like a man reading out a list.

fomin.name: Fomin (trusty)
fomin.description: A well-fed man in his thirties with a Russian accent speaking English. Smooth, friendly, slightly oily, the voice of someone who eats indoors. Confidential, close to the microphone, a little too pleasant.

pasha.name: Pasha (foreman)
pasha.description: A man in his fifties with a heavy Russian accent speaking English. Deep, hoarse, tired, a working man's voice worn by cold and shouting. Direct and unsentimental, but not cruel.

lev.name: Lev (student)
lev.description: A nineteen-year-old student from Leningrad with a soft Russian accent speaking English. A light, young, high tenor voice, thin and breathy from hunger, a little hoarse; quick, clever, ironic, quiet, with no self-pity. Clearly younger and lighter than the other men in the camp.

kuzma.name: Kuzma (peasant)
kuzma.description: An old peasant in his sixties with a thick rural Russian accent speaking English. Warm, slow, storytelling cadence, gravelly, missing teeth. Sounds like he is talking to a stove.

vaska.name: Vaska Kosoi (criminal)
vaska.description: A criminal in his thirties with a Russian accent speaking English. Lazy, amused and menacing, a smoker's voice, speaks softly because he never needs to shout.

alyosha.name: Alyoshka (Baptist)
alyosha.description: A gentle man in his forties with a soft Russian accent speaking English. A Baptist believer: calm, warm, unhurried, with a quiet certainty and a little hoarseness from the cold.

smith.name: The blacksmith's man
smith.description: A wiry man in his fifties with a Russian accent speaking English. Quick, low and conspiratorial, a black-market dealer's murmur, very precise about prices.

commissioner.name: The commissioner
commissioner.description: A Moscow official in his fifties with a Russian accent speaking English. Smooth, educated, bored and patronising, the voice of a man saying a phrase he has said many times before.

nina.name: Nina (wife)
nina.description: A woman in her thirties with a Russian accent speaking English. Tired, tender and restrained, reading aloud a letter she wrote to her husband in a labour camp, careful not to cry.

prisoner.name: The prisoner (you)
prisoner.description: A man of about forty with a Russian accent speaking English. Educated but worn down: quiet, hoarse from the cold, tired. He speaks plainly and briefly, without drama, like a man who has learned to say as little as possible.

lubimov_count.text: Пять. Десять. Пятнадцать. Двадцать. Двадцать пять... Ещё раз. Сначала.

lubimov_tenmore.text: Ten years. Additional. Read and signed.

fomin_kum.text: The kum asked about you. Nothing bad. He likes to know who people are.

fomin_bootmakers.text: There is a place coming free in the bootmakers'. Warm. He said you might be the kind who notices things.

fomin_name.text: A name. Anyone. Kuzma talks at night. Everybody hears him.

fomin_carrier.text: For carrying. Don't spend it all.

pasha_percentage.text: The percentage is a hundred and twenty.

pasha_name.text: The inspector takes the sheet. Somebody has to have done the measuring. I need a name that is not mine.

pasha_short.text: We are short. Everyone's bread is cut tomorrow. Everyone knows why.

lev_quote.text: Pain and suffering are always inevitable for a large intelligence and a deep heart.

lev_omsk.text: A man who did four years in Omsk. He wrote it afterwards, with a full stomach.

kuzma_river.text: Downriver, three days on the ice, there is the free settlement. Released men, who cannot leave. They will feed you. Then they will sell you back, because they are hungry too. Upriver there is nothing.

kuzma_spoon.text: The dead do not need spoons. The living do.

vaska_jacket.text: Nice jacket. Warm, is it? Take it off. I want to see if it is warm.

alyosha_keep.text: Give it to me. I keep mine under the boards by my bunk. God sees it, and so do the rats. But the rats are lazier than the warders.

kuzma_tenth.text: After the tenth, the river will not hold a man. Before that it holds him. But it does not like it.

kuzma_cough.text: If. You know. If. Keep the spoon. It is a good spoon.

smith_three.text: I hear you are a man who thinks about fences. I have fifteen centimetres of good steel. Three pinches of tobacco. Not two. Three.

commissioner_complaints.text: Any complaints, prisoners? Speak freely. The Soviet state listens. Nobody is punished for an honest complaint.

pasha_stove.text: One stick each. Whoever carries nothing sits by the door tonight.

pasha_escape.text: Two men went over the wire last night. Thank them for the next week.

lev_repay.text: I told you I would pay you back. You didn't believe me. Neither did I.

lev_map.text: Forty-one kilometres. Don't tell me what it's for.

nina_letter1.text: The collective farm paid for the year in workdays. I paint carpets on canvas now, and sell them at the station. Swans, mostly. Are you well?

nina_letter2.text: They will not take Tanya at the institute, with a father like hers. The man at the district office says, if I sign the paper... I have signed it. Forgive me.

prisoner_complaint.text: The bread is short weight. The men are dying.

amb_wind.text: Constant cold wind blowing over a frozen river at night, open tundra, low howling with distant creaking of ice, no music, no voices

amb_hut.text: Inside a large dark wooden barracks at night, many men asleep: slow, deep, quiet breathing all around, calm and even, very rarely one soft snore far away across the room, a wood stove ticking faintly, no loud snoring, no voices, no music

amb_site.text: Outdoor work site in deep winter: pickaxes striking frozen ground, distant shouted orders, wind, a saw, creaking sledges, no music

amb_queue.text: A crowded camp mess hall: iron bowls clanking, a ladle scraping a large pot, low murmur of many men, boots on wooden floor, no music

amb_cells.text: Near silence inside a small unheated wooden cell: a slow water drip, faint wind through a crack, a distant dog once, room tone

amb_march.text: A column of hundreds of men marching on packed snow in the dark, crunching boots in rhythm, wind, a guard dog barking far away, no music

rail.text: Prison camp wake-up signal before dawn: a man beats a hammer on a length of iron rail hanging from a post, clang, clang, clang, a dozen slow even blows one after another, about one a second, continuing the whole time, each blow ringing like a cracked bell, heard from a little distance through a wooden hut wall in frosty air, no voices, no music

boots.text: A few footsteps of heavy felt boots on packed dry snow, close, crunching

ladle.text: A heavy iron ladle struck flat against a wooden table, single sharp hit

door.text: A heavy wooden barracks door slammed shut with an iron latch, wind cut off

dogs.text: Two guard dogs barking far away across snow at night, distant, echoing

shot.text: A single rifle shot at night from a wooden tower, sharp crack, long echo over flat frozen land, then silence

lorry.text: An old Soviet lorry engine idling in the cold and pulling away on snow, 1950s truck

paper.text: A folded letter being unfolded slowly, old thin paper, close

bread.text: A small loaf of dense rye bread being torn in half by hand, close, crust cracking

humming.text: An old man humming a slow sad Russian folk melody very quietly to himself, no words, gravelly voice, intimate

pulse.text: A slow heavy human heartbeat heard from inside the body, muffled, around fifty beats per minute, with faint high ringing in the ears

searchlight.text: A large electric searchlight humming and slowly sweeping, mechanical rotation creak, buzzing arc lamp, outdoors at night

amb_blizzard.text: A violent blizzard howling against a wooden barracks at night, snow hissing on the walls and the small window, timbers creaking, no music, no voices

amb_spring.text: Early spring thaw in the far north: meltwater dripping from a roof, water trickling in ruts, distant cracking of river ice, a few small birds, cold wind, no music

ice_break.text: A frozen river breaking up in spring: huge ice floes cracking like distant artillery, grinding and groaning against each other, rushing water

fight.text: A short brutal scuffle inside a wooden hut: bodies thrown against planks, a grunt, a punch, boots scraping on the floor

pencil.text: A stub of pencil writing quickly on rough paper, close up, a few short strokes

amb_hut_morning.text: A crowded wooden barracks waking before dawn in winter: men coughing and clearing their throats, felt boots shuffling on wooden floorboards, a stove door clanking, low muttered voices, blankets, wind outside. No snoring, no music

crying.text: A grown man crying very quietly in the dark, trying not to be heard, muffled into a blanket, a few suppressed sobs and a shaky breath, close but very soft

prayer.text: Two or three men murmuring a prayer very quietly together in a dark room, indistinct words, low steady rhythm like counting, no singing

cough.text: A thin man coughing a deep wet cough in a cold wooden room, a few coughs, then a wheeze

drip.text: Meltwater dripping slowly from a wooden roof beam into a small puddle, single drops, quiet room

raven.text: A single raven croaking twice in cold still winter air, outdoors, at a little distance

bed_wind_walls.text: Heard from inside a wooden barracks at night: a steady winter wind pressing on the log walls, low rumble, the occasional rattle of a loose window pane, no voices, no music

bed_wind_snow.text: Outdoors on an open frozen plain: a steady cold wind with fine dry snow hissing over a hard crust, no voices, no music

bed_stove.text: A small iron wood stove burning close by in a quiet room: soft crackling, the hiss of damp wood, occasional pop and tick of hot metal, no voices, no music

bed_bulb.text: A single bare electric light bulb humming faintly on a long wire in a quiet room, a very soft steady electrical buzz

bed_spoons.text: Many tin spoons scraping and knocking on tin bowls in a crowded hall, close, steady, with low murmuring, no music

spot_gust.text: A single strong gust of winter wind howling past the corner of a wooden building and dying away

spot_creak.text: A soft distant creak of an old wooden bunk somewhere across a dark barracks as a sleeper shifts, one low gentle creak, muffled, far away, quiet

spot_door_far.text: A wooden door banging shut somewhere far away across a camp in the wind, distant

spot_shout_far.text: A guard shouting a short order far away outdoors in the cold, indistinct words, echoing faintly

spot_ice_crack.text: River ice cracking far away on a frozen river, a deep low boom that rolls and fades

spot_pick.text: A single pickaxe striking frozen ground nearby, a hard dull ring, outdoors

spot_crow.text: Two crows calling far off over a snowy field, faint

log_drag.text: Two men dragging a heavy wet log on a rope over packed snow and frozen ground outdoors: the log scraping and bumping, the rope creaking taut, both men grunting and breathing hard with effort, boots crunching in snow, cold wind, no music

bed_fire_out.text: An open wood fire burning outdoors on snow in winter wind: logs crackling and popping, flames fluttering and roaring softly as the wind gusts, steady, no voices, no music

pat_down.text: A guard quickly searching a man: hands slapping and patting down a thick padded quilted cotton jacket and trousers, fast muffled pats on heavy fabric, close, no voices

spot_snow_steps.text: A few slow footsteps crunching on dry packed snow outdoors, one person in felt boots approaching from a little distance and stopping, cold still air
